text_en: Praise the Lord ! How good it is to sing praises to our God; for he is gracious, and a song of praise is fitting.
text_cn: 亚肋路亚！ 赞美上主，因他是美善的， 歌颂我主，因他是甘甜的， 我主上主是应受赞美的！

text_en: The Lord builds up Jerusalem; he gathers the outcasts of Israel.
text_cn: 上主重建了耶路撒冷城， 完聚了四散的以色列民。

text_en: He heals the brokenhearted, and binds up their wounds.
text_cn: 他医治了心灵破碎的人， 也亲自包扎了他的伤痕。

text_en: He determines the number of the stars; he gives to all of them their names.
text_cn: 星辰的数目，全由上主制定， 星辰的称号，也都由他命名。

text_en: Great is our Lord, and abundant in power; his understanding is beyond measure.
text_cn: 我们的伟大上主，威能无比， 他所具备的智慧，不可估计。

text_en: The Lord lifts up the downtrodden; he casts the wicked to the ground.
text_cn: 上主将谦逊的人扶起， 将蛮横的人贬抑于地。

text_en: Sing to the Lord with thanksgiving; make melody to our God on the lyre.
text_cn: 请歌唱谢恩诗称颂上主， 请弹琴咏赞我们的天主！

text_en: He covers the heavens with clouds, prepares rain for the earth, makes grass grow on the hills.
text_cn: 他以云雾遮蔽高天， 他将雨露赐给农田； 他使青草生于群山， 他造植物供人吃穿。

text_en: He gives to the animals their food, and to the young ravens when they cry.
text_cn: 他将食物赐给家畜， 他养育啼叫的鸦雏。

text_en: His delight is not in the strength of the horse, nor his pleasure in the speed of a runner;
text_cn: 马的壮力，他不欢喜， 人的快腿，他不中意，

text_en: but the Lord takes pleasure in those who fear him, in those who hope in his steadfast love.
text_cn: 那敬畏上主的人，他才欢喜， 信赖他慈爱的人，他才中意。

text_en: Praise the Lord , O Jerusalem! Praise your God, O Zion!
text_cn: 耶路撒冷，请你赞颂上主！ 熙雍，请你赞颂你的天主！

text_en: For he strengthens the bars of your gates; he blesses your children within you.
text_cn: 他巩固了你城门的横闩， 祝福你的子女在你中间。

text_en: He grants peace within your borders; he fills you with the finest of wheat.
text_cn: 他使你的地界安静不乱， 用最好的麦面使你饱餐。

text_en: He sends out his command to the earth; his word runs swiftly.
text_cn: 他向大地发出自己的语言， 他的圣旨便立即迅速奔传。

text_en: He gives snow like wool; he scatters frost like ashes.
text_cn: 他降雪像羊毛， 他撒霜像尘宵。

text_en: He hurls down hail like crumbs— who can stand before his cold?
text_cn: 他抛下冰雹，有如饼屑， 因他的严寒，水便冻结；

text_en: He sends out his word, and melts them; he makes his wind blow, and the waters flow.
text_cn: 他一发出他的语言，冻结即刻消溶， 他一吹起他的和风，冰水即刻流动。

text_en: He declares his word to Jacob, his statutes and ordinances to Israel.
text_cn: 他向雅各伯晓示了自己的言语， 他向以色列启示了自己的诫律。

text_en: He has not dealt thus with any other nation; they do not know his ordinances. Praise the Lord !
text_cn: 他从未如此恩待过其他任何民族， 也没有向他们宣示过自己的法律。
